descriptionChirho: A bed or couch used for sleeping or resting, the general sense of the word referring to ordinary furniture for lying down at night.
A bed upon which one lies during illness, used in the specific context of suffering or being confined by disease.
An ornate couch or divan used for reclining in luxury, connoting wealth, ease, and indulgent comfort.
A large bedstead or bed-frame, as in the famous iron bed of Og king of Bashan, possibly functioning as a funerary bier or sarcophagus.
